name: Silage evam Dudharu Pashu Poshan Yojana
benefit: - Under this scheme, members of milk cooperative societies in hilly and plain rural areas are provided with quality mineral mixtures and probiotics at current rates, receive a 75% subsidy on silage including an upfront subsidy of ₹2.00 per kg. - Compact feed blocks are available at a 50% subsidy, costing the beneficiary ₹8.00 per kg.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a member of a milk-producing cooperative society supplying milk to the society.
